subject: Runway top-up options: credit bucket vs short extension
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@vantagerx.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: VantageRx Procurement <procurement@vantagerx.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: quick options for extending pilot runway

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the call this morning — the POC is showing promise, but our ML team needs a bit more runway to complete a second integration pass. We have two practical asks from procurement and engineering:

- Option A: Add 2 weeks to the current time-boxed pilot (same SOW, minor amendment).
- Option B: Buy a token/usage bucket (credit pool) we can draw down for spikes over the next 30 days.

Procurement asked for high-level pricing for both options so they can route approvals internally this week. Could you send numbers and any constraints (throughput caps, soft SLOs, required lead time)? If you have a sample amendment / SOW diff that would help speed things up.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we are trying to keep momentum.

Best,
Emma
VP, Data Platform
VantageRx

--
Attachment: initial_poc_findings.pdf (report, 1.2MB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@vantagerx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: quick options for extending pilot runway

Emma — thanks for the note and congrats to the team on the progress. We can support both approaches; here are quick, executable options you can take to procurement: 

1) Time-box extension (2 weeks)
   - What it covers: additional calendar days for the existing pilot artifacts and SOW. No changes to per-token billing; we keep the same evaluation terms.
   - Pricing: $9,000 flat for the 2-week extension (one-time amendment fee).
   - Notes: No changes to throughput, same resource allocation; if you need burst CPU/GPU beyond baseline we can add surge capacity (see option 3).

2) Credit bucket (30-day drawdown)
   - What it covers: a prepaid token/usage pool you can consume for extra inference during testing spikes.
   - Pricing tiers (preliminary):
     * Small: 50k token bucket — $4,000
     * Medium: 100k token bucket — $7,500
     * Large: 250k token bucket — $16,000
   - Notes: Unused credits expire after 30 days; can be applied to conversion/commit if you decide to convert to a Dedicated commit within 90 days.

3) Hybrid: 1-week extension + 50k credit bucket — $6,500 (discounted bundle).

I attached a draft amendment (SOW-draft-v1.docx) and a short PDF that outlines the amendment changes (POC-extension-options.pdf). Monica, can you confirm capacity/throughput constraints for the 100k bucket and whether ops needs lead time to provision burst nodes?

If procurement prefers the credit bucket we can generate an amendment and DocuSign link today — I'll loop legal and ops once you confirm the tier.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: POC-extension-options.pdf, SOW-draft-v1.docx
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@vantagerx.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: quick options for extending pilot runway

Emma / team — quick ops confirm from my side:

- Baseline for your current pilot supports ~40k tokens/day sustained with KV cache warming we saw in your traces.
- We can provision burst capacity to cover spikes up to 120k tokens/day for short windows (hours) if you take the 100k or 250k bucket.
- Lead time: burst pools typically take 24–48 hours to provision if nodes are not already warm. For a pure time-box extension we do not need additional lead time.

Operational impact and recommendation:
- If you expect continual elevated traffic during the next two weeks, go for the 100k bucket (Medium). That gives headroom for re-integration testing and load tests.
- If the spikes will be confined to a few hours for scheduled runs, we can do ad-hoc surge provisioning but you'll want the 100k bucket to avoid throttling while nodes warm.

Pricing note (ops): the bucket pricing above assumes standard quantization/FP16 runtime; if you require higher-precision runs the effective token burn rate changes and we'll need to adjust.

Attached a short ops note for procurement to include with the amendment (ops_capacity_notes.txt).

—Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@vantagerx.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: quick options for extending pilot runway

Thanks Karthik and Monica — that all helps. Procurement is leaning toward the Medium credit bucket (100k) rather than a straight time extension because our QA runs are bursty and we want the flexibility. A couple quick asks: 

1) Can you send a short amendment (one-page) that lists the token bucket, expiration, and billing line item so procurement can autoapprove?
2) Please include the expected lead time (24–48h) in the amendment so engineering can schedule tests.
3) If possible, provide a draft DocuSign link for signatures so we can close today.

If you can send the DocuSign and the one-page amendment I’ll have procurement sign off and route to legal.

Best,
Emma
